name: keep-keys
description: Store local secrets outside chat and let your agent use them through approval-gated commands.

interface.shortDescription: Local secrets for approved agent commands
interface.longDescription: KeepKeys opens a native secure-entry prompt, stores named secrets in macOS Keychain, and lets your agent use them only through commands you review and approve. Secret values are never returned to the model.
defaultPrompt: Store a new secret with KeepKeys.
Use a KeepKeys secret for this command.
